source_declaration.complete_header:
theorem visible_chamber_generic_preserving_nonzero_chi
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (P : WeakTuple n) :
    ∃ Q : GenericTuple n,
      (⟨Q.val, generic_implies_weak hn Q.property⟩ : WeakTuple n) ∈
        labelledVisibleChamber P ∧
      ∀ i j k : ZMod n, chi P.val i j k ≠ 0 →
        chi Q.val i j k = chi P.val i j k

findings: P ranges over every WeakTuple with n ≥ 3. A NeZero n instance is derived from that inequality. There is no G1 or Generic premise at P and no bound on its zero triples.

The actual connected component image contains P and is ambient open by weak_visible_components. Filter.inter_mem combines its neighborhood with finite_nonzero_chi_persists for all ordered triples simultaneously.
mem_nhds_iff supplies an actual nonempty open subset containing P. generic_in_nonempty_open supplies a full Generic tuple there, rather than only a G1 tuple.

The image witness W is transported by Subtype.ext to the exact WeakTuple representative constructed by generic_implies_weak. Thus chamber membership and all initially nonzero ordered signs refer to the same generic Q.
First failed artifacts are preserved. The repair changed no theorem type. The successful second root kernel has only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
